L26: Unidirectional Key Update in Updatable Encryption, Revisited Article
L27: 
L28: Authors: M. Jurkiewicz ; K. Prabucka
L29: In this paper we construct a new efficient updatable encryption (UE) scheme based on FrodoPKE learning with errors key encapsulation. We analyse the security of the proposed scheme in the backward-leak uni-directional setting within the rand-ind-eu-cpa model. Since the underlying computationally hard problem here is LWE, the scheme is secure against both classical and quantum attacks.
